messages:
Sam T: getting reports: svc-a -> svc-b mTLS handshakes failing in ap-south and eu-west-2, ~15% error rate since ~6169019600. clients see 'certificate verify failed: unknown CA'. anyone oncall?
Elena V: i'm seeing same in traces. interestingly, failures cluster around nodes that were recently rotated by cert-rotator at 6169019400.
Ravi K: ops-bot shows a cert rotation job completed then a subsequent keystore rekey at 6169019450. pinging keystore-audit-bot for KMS unwrap results.
keystore-audit-bot: recent KMS Decrypt DENY for principal=role:cert-rotator-unwrap in ap-south at 6169019462. sample: `ERROR KMSDecryptDenied principal=role:cert-rotator-unwrap resource=arn:kms:ap-south:... status=AccessDenied`.
Sam T: if the rotator couldn't unwrap the CA signing key, proxies might have served a partial chain or self-signed leaf, causing client verification to fail.
Elena V: i pulled a failing connection capture: `openssl s_client -connect svc-b.ap-south.redwood.ai:8443 -showcerts` shows only leaf cert and no intermediate, and chain verification fails.
Ravi K: ACL change PR #8240 removed KMS decrypt from role cert-rotator-unwrap during RBAC cleanup (auth-admin). rolled out at 6169019405.
security-oncall: this smells like an RBAC jockeying issue. quick mitigation options?
Elena V: short-term: revert the RBAC PR or restore KMS decrypt for the role. medium-term: add a pre-deploy keystore health-check gating step to cert-rotator.
Sam T: i can temporarily enable cert-rotator fallback to use cached intermediate (read-only ephemeral) so chain is served while we fix KMS permissions. note: fallback reduces forward secrecy guarantees briefly, flagging for compliance.
Ravi K: executing RBAC restore now (rolling). also instrumenting audit to keep all unwrap attempts for 7d.
keystore-audit-bot: RBAC change applied by Ravi K at 6169020065; beginning rehydrate/unwrap attempts. previous unwraps now returning SUCCESS.
Elena V: after RBAC restore, new connections show full chain and client verify failures drop to <0.5%. good.
security-oncall: write-up action items: 1) revert RBAC cleanup process to require keystore-unlock test; 2) add canary and health-check to cert-rotator (unit + integration); 3) keep verbose keystore audit for 7d and ship to S3; 4) add alert on missing intermediate certs served by proxies.
Sam T: i'll open postmortem and tag product/compliance. include curl/openssl repro and keystore audit logs.
Ravi K: also scheduling a RBAC review with auth-admins to avoid accidental removal of service decrypt perms.
Elena V: final check 6169020300: mTLS error rate back to baseline, rotation pipeline healthy. closing incident as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
